text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day before the Arima Kinen, and Tamamo Cross casually inspects the track before the big race. Surprisingly, she's not the slightest bit anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt about it—she's matured. I'm certain Tamamo Cross will overwhelm her rivals with her perfected form and spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this run set to be her last, Tamamo Cross is eager to shock the world during this final opportunity to unleash her lightning.
